issues.evidence: The Pi header 3V3 pin (J101 pin 1) is on net +3.3VP, which only reaches fan header J102. Every on-board 3.3 V load (74LVC138 U102, LPC2102 U601 VDD/VDDA/VBAT, IMU and pressure stamps J104/J105, pull-ups R103, LED anodes) is on the separate power net +3V3, which has no regulator or connection to any source.
issues.why_it_matters: As netlisted, the PCB leaves the whole 3.3 V logic rail unconnected (different power-symbol names = different nets)
issues.time_or_money: board does not power up; respin or bodge wire

issues.evidence: +1V8 feeds LPC2102 VDD(1V8) core pin 5 and the ICM-20948 stamp 1V8 pin (J104 pin 1 -> ICM-20948 VDD/VDDIO and TXS0108E VCCA on the stamp), but no regulator or supply drives +1V8 anywhere in the design. LPC2101/2/3 require an external 1.8 V core supply.
issues.why_it_matters: Timer MCU core and IMU are unpowered

issues.evidence: Resistor arrays valued '330' but Part Number EXB-28V680JX / Digikey Y7680CT-ND are 68 ohm arrays; sheet note says 'Red, yellow, green, and white diodes get 68R'
issues.why_it_matters: Schematic value and purchased part disagree; LED currents differ 5x depending on which is fitted

issues.evidence: With the specified 68 ohm arrays, red/yellow/green LEDs from +3V3 sink ~16-19 mA into LPC2102 P0.8/P0.9/P0.13 (spec IOL 4 mA) and Raspberry Pi GPIO24 (16 mA max)
issues.why_it_matters: Exceeds GPIO sink ratings; VOL rises and pins/Pi GPIO stressed
issues.time_or_money: use 330R as the value field says

issues.evidence: LPC2102 P0.14 (ISP-entry strap, sampled at reset) is pulled DOWN by R103 (pins 3-6, 10k to GND) while indicator LED D144 + R102 pulls it up from +3V3; with Pi GPIO24 high-Z the node settles ~1.5 V (between VIL 0.8 V and VIH 2.0 V)
issues.why_it_matters: Boot mode is undefined / LPC enters the ISP bootloader on every reset unless the Pi actively drives GPIO24

issues.evidence: OSHW logo G703 (Stamp Tester sheet) uses Device:Q_PMOS_GSD symbol with in_bom yes; BOM lists a 3-pin PMOS 'OSHW'
issues.why_it_matters: Spurious BOM line / unconnected-pin ERC noise

issues.evidence: U102 value '74LS138' (5 V TTL, not 3.3 V capable) while Part Number is 74LVC138APW,118
issues.why_it_matters: Value field would mislead a substitute/assembler into a part that does not work at 3.3 V

acceptable_designs.reason: Stamp SDA/SCL pads are tied to the SPI MOSI/SCK nets; sensors run in SPI mode, no I2C bus is used (sheet note: 'Leave I2C free')
Labels on no-connect-flagged LPC pins reserved for later use
DBGSEL has internal pull-down and RTC oscillator pins left open, both documented in sheet notes
ZED-F9R breakout 3V3 pins are outputs of the breakout's own regulator; unused breakout I/O left open
Unused TXS0108E A5/A7/A8 tied to GND with B side open is acceptable
ICM-20948 REGOUT has C310 100 nF and VDD/VDDIO have C302/C308/C313
Every indicator LED has a series element in resistor arrays R101/R102
HAT header and fan header only pass the Raspberry Pi's own supplies
Stamp-tester pass-through headers, powered by the host
No HAT ID EEPROM; not required for a custom add-on board
LEDs valued by colour with full MPNs

notes: Raspberry Pi HAT with LPC2102 timestamp co-processor, 74LVC138 SPI CS decoder, ICM-20948 and BME280 SPI 'stamp' sub-boards (with TXS0108E 1.8V<->3.3V on the IMU stamp), ZED-F9R GNSS breakout. Despite the slug, no I2C bus is used. Biggest problems are power: +3V3 is a different net from the Pi's +3.3VP and +1V8 has no source.
